children: South Korean shipping company HMM is likely to post a 3Q earnings beat on higher-than-expected freight rates, says Shinhan Securities' Minki Choi. Container freight rates are surging on strong cargo volumes ahead of anticipated changes to U.S.-China tariffs and supply disruptions caused by typhoons in China, the analyst writes in a note. Port congestion in the West and bottlenecks at the Panama Canal are also pushing rates higher, Choi says. He expects HMM's operating profit to have more than tripled to 1.004 trillion won for the July-September quarter, beating a market consensus estimate of 686.50 billion won. Shinhan upgrades its rating on the stock to buy from neutral and raises its target price by 30% to 26,000 won. Shares are 6.1% higher at 23,400 won.(kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
